color.note: Monochrome by design: hierarchy comes from lightness steps and translucent glass, never from hue. The only hue is the notification dot. Dark is the primary theme; Light is derived from it.

tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page ground: the screen behind lists, transactions and the tab bar.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Cards on the ground: category cards, dark pill buttons (Deposit, Withdraw).

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised controls: round icon buttons, icon wells inside cards.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Bubbles and the floating tab bar.

tokens.name: surface-400
tokens.usage: Selected state: the active tab chip.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between transaction rows and card borders. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that mark a control (pill buttons, trend pill): at least 3:1 on surface-000, surface-100 and surface-200 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, amounts and icons on every surface and on glass.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (dates, 'View All', tab labels, the first half of a two-tone heading) on surface-000 to surface-400 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text such as cents after the decimal. Only on surface-000, surface-100 and surface-200 (4.5:1 there in both themes).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill (solid button, active bar).

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Frosted fill for the balance card, the greeting chip and the Get Started pill. Pair with blur-glass.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Glass in its hover or pressed state; the lit slice of a spending bubble.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px edge on glass surfaces.

tokens.name: chart-lit
tokens.usage: The highlighted bars of a sparkline: the period in focus.

tokens.name: chart-dim
tokens.usage: Context bars of a sparkline, outside the focus period.

tokens.name: notify
tokens.usage: Notification dot only (sampled from the bell). Never text, never a status colour.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring with a 2px offset in the ground colour.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Onboarding headline, centred, two-tone (ink-muted then ink).

styles.name: balance
styles.usage: The one headline figure per screen (account balance).

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Row titles, button labels, row amounts.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Dates, 'View All', percentages under a category.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside a tab.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between pill buttons; title-to-date in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Icon well to text in a row; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Balance card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between screen sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small inner elements.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Category cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Balance card, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, chip, tab bar and icon button: controls are always pills or circles.

shadow.note: Depth is a top-edge highlight plus a soft dark drop, never a coloured glow.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Glass surfaces and the floating tab bar.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Pill and round buttons.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur for every glass surface.
